column1: # Commonly ordered clinical genetic tests that whole-genome data can address, and how this report covers each. Gene lists are fact lists compiled from the cited
# guidelines/panels; they are screened against ClinVar P/LP (exact SNV/indel matches). kind: genes = ClinVar P/LP screen; snps = curated panel rsIDs; module = optional module in results.

column6: limits
ClinVar P/LP SNVs and short indels only; LDLR exon deletions (a common FH cause) are not seen. Compare with the LDL score and measured LDL.
SNVs and short indels in ClinVar only; large deletions and variants of uncertain significance are not assessed. TTN truncations are in the loss-of-function scan if run.
As above. KCNQ1, KCNH2 and SCN5A have many variants of uncertain significance that are not interpreted here.

column2: Aortopathy / connective-tissue panel (Marfan, Loeys-Dietz, vascular Ehlers-Danlos)
column6: As above; FBN1 deletions and splice-region variants outside ClinVar are not assessed.
Genome-wide plus explicit-variant estimate; KIV-2 repeat count needs a CRAM and gives a diploid total only.
Two variants; antithrombin, protein C and protein S deficiencies are in the ClinVar screen only.
Penetrance is incomplete; ferritin and transferrin saturation decide clinical relevance.
HbS only. HBB beta-thalassemia variants are in the ClinVar screen; alpha-thalassemia (HBA deletions) needs the copy-number module.
One A- variant; other G6PD variants are in the ClinVar screen only.

column2: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (Z and S alleles)
column6: Common alleles only; rare SERPINA1 variants depend on ClinVar.
A proxy for DQ2.5; DQ8 is not tagged. A negative proxy makes celiac less likely, never excludes it.
Tag SNP for the TA-repeat variant; the repeat itself is not genotyped.
ClinVar P/LP only; GCK and HNF1A variants of uncertain significance are not interpreted.
Single heterozygous ClinVar variants only; CFTR large rearrangements and 5T/TG-repeat variants are not assessed. A negative result does not rule out carrier status.
Read-depth screen of these changes only; not a genome-wide microarray; not tested on a known deletion; needs a CRAM.

column2: BRCA1/2, Lynch syndrome and other cancer panels
column6: Exon-level deletions and duplications (common in BRCA1, MSH2, EPCAM) are not seen; PMS2 is poorly resolved by short reads. See the cancer section.
ClinVar P/LP SNVs and indels only.
PKD1 has pseudogenes that short reads resolve poorly; a negative result is weak evidence.

column2: Repeat-expansion disorders (Huntington, Fragile X, myotonic dystrophy, C9orf72 ALS)
column6: ExpansionHunter on a CRAM; repeat sizes beyond read length are lower bounds and interruptions are not assessed.

column2: Chromosome gains and losses / sex-chromosome aneuploidy
column6: Read-depth dosage; detects whole-chromosome changes only, not a karyotype or microarray.
See the drug response section: limited screens of 13 genes, CPIC-based.

column2: HLA typing (abacavir B*57:01, carbamazepine B*15:02, allopurinol B*58:01)
column6: Needs T1K on a CRAM; the SNP proxy is not HLA typing.
